description: Execution Safety policy for the NDC Admin Portal on shared staging (STG). Machine-readable and authoritative for evaluation; execution_safety_policy.md beside this file explains it for reviewers and records the provenance of every rule. Every rule below is either migrated from existing project evidence or is a flagged conservative default -- none was invented because it seemed reasonable. Version 2 (2026-09-28, HD-SAFETY-006) added a narrow SelfCreated carve-out for booking/financial actions, for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5.

*.reason: No rule in this policy covers the operation. On a shared staging environment an uncategorised operation fails closed rather than proceeding.
*.source: Conservative default (execution_safety README, Missing Policy Behavior)

ProductionLike.reason: Data classified ProductionLike carries production-level business impact. Nothing acts on it under this policy except reading.
ProductionLike.source: Conservative default -- no project evidence classifies any STG record as ProductionLike

Shared.reason: Searching, filtering, paginating and viewing pre-existing records is not mutation and is fully in scope.
Shared.source: run_configuration.md, run-003 override: "Reading is unrestricted... this is most of US 8599's surface."

Unknown.reason: Reading data of unproven ownership changes nothing. Ownership matters at the point of mutation, not observation.

SelfCreated.reason: Mutating a record this run created still requires an explicit, run-scoped grant. Every run so far has needed one, including to create its own seed data.
SelfCreated.source: run_configuration.md -- all three run-specific mutation overrides (2026-07-31, 2026-08-03, 2026-08-04) were necessary grants; the standing default is read-only

DedicatedTestData.reason: A persistent record reserved for testing is still shared across runs over time, so a grant is scoped to one run.
DedicatedTestData.source: Conservative default -- no STG record is currently designated DedicatedTestData

Shared.reason: Ordinary mutation of an existing record on shared staging requires an explicit, run-scoped human authorization, and the original values must be captured before the change and restored after it.
Shared.source: run_configuration.md, Environment Constraints: "Standing default is read-only -- no data mutation is authorized unless a run-specific override below grants it"; HD-SAFETY-001 (Option A, 2026-08-07)

Unknown.reason: Ownership could not be proven, so the record is treated as somebody else's until shown otherwise. Unknown is never treated as SelfCreated.
Unknown.source: run_configuration.md: run-002's own records are "treated as pre-existing (conservative reading)" -- the project's established precedent for unprovable ownership

ProductionLike.reason: No mutation of production-impact data is permitted on this environment, at any scope.

SelfCreated.reason: Submit / Approve / Reject on a record this run created was explicitly granted in each of the three runs to date, never assumed.
SelfCreated.source: run_configuration.md, run-001 ("Submit for Approval, Approve, and Reject"), run-002 (same), run-003 ("the full action set on records this run created")

DedicatedTestData.source: Conservative default -- parity with SelfCreated, no evidence either way

Shared.reason: Approving or rejecting a record this run did not create is not reversible by re-running the test, and a pending record on shared staging may belong to another team's in-flight work.
Shared.source: modules/branch/context/ProjectContext.md S5: "approve/reject changes the state of a record that may not be this effort's to change... not reversible by re-running the test"; run_configuration.md, run-003 override, Forbidden #2

Unknown.reason: An approval decision cannot be taken on a record whose ownership is unproven -- irreversibility and unprovable ownership together admit no safe outcome.
Unknown.source: Conservative default, following the Shared prohibition above

*.reason: An outbound notification leaves the environment and reaches real recipients. Nothing recalls it, and no project document authorizes sending one.
*.source: Conservative default -- no project evidence addresses outbound notifications

SelfCreated.reason: Booking-lifecycle actions against a booking this run itself creates (Ancillaries/AirIndia test bookings) require an explicit, run-scoped authorization -- never a blanket permission. Every other ownership class stays absolutely forbidden below.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-006 (user-approved 2026-09-28), scoped narrowly to SelfCreated for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5

*.reason: Booking-lifecycle actions are prohibited on this environment. The prohibition has been restated, unlifted, in every run-specific override granted to date.
*.source: run_configuration.md -- all three overrides: "No bookings, payments, wallet charges, top-ups, holds, or ticketing are permitted, even in service of verifying a Reflection-area effect"

SelfCreated.reason: Financial actions (payment, wallet charge) against a booking this run itself creates require an explicit, run-scoped authorization -- never a blanket permission. Every other ownership class stays absolutely forbidden below.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-006 (user-approved 2026-09-28), scoped narrowly to SelfCreated for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5

*.reason: Financial actions are prohibited on this environment. Financial operations never inherit ordinary mutation defaults.
*.source: run_configuration.md -- all three overrides, standing prohibition, never lifted

*.reason: Changing a credential or a role's permissions alters who can do what, for everyone on a shared environment, beyond the run that changed it.
*.source: Conservative default -- no project evidence addresses credential or role/permission changes

SelfCreated.reason: Deleting a record this run created requires a scoped human approval. Permission to UPDATE never includes permission to DELETE.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-002 (Option A, human decision, 2026-08-07) -- DELETE appears in none of the three historical grants, so no evidence permitted it and none prohibited it

DedicatedTestData.reason: A record reserved for testing outlives the run that deletes it, so removing it is a scoped decision, not routine cleanup.

Shared.reason: Deleting a record this run did not create is irreversible and may destroy another team's in-flight work.
Shared.source: run_configuration.md, run-003 override, Forbidden #2: "Any mutation of a Branch record this run did not create -- including editing, approving, rejecting, or deleting"; HD-SAFETY-001 (destructive shared-record prohibitions remain absolute)

Unknown.reason: A deletion that cannot be proven safe is not performed. Unknown is never treated as SelfCreated.

Shared.reason: Attaching a document to a record this run does not own adds data another team did not put there and may not notice.
Shared.source: Conservative default -- informed by modules/agency/discovery/findings/FINDING-004, where a document attachment was a real mutation of an existing Agency record

SelfCreated.reason: A payment against a booking this run itself creates, on STG_PORTAL/ANCILLARIES_STG, requires an explicit run-scoped authorization before it executes.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-006 (user-approved 2026-09-28), scoped narrowly for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5

*.reason: Payments are prohibited on this environment.
*.source: run_configuration.md -- named verbatim in all three run-specific override limits; modules/branch/context/ProjectContext.md S5

*.reason: Top-ups are prohibited on this environment.
*.source: run_configuration.md -- named verbatim ("top-ups") in all three run-specific override limits

SelfCreated.reason: A wallet deduction against a booking this run itself creates, on STG_PORTAL/ANCILLARIES_STG, requires an explicit run-scoped authorization before it executes.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-006 (user-approved 2026-09-28), scoped narrowly for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5

*.reason: Wallet charges are prohibited on this environment.
*.source: run_configuration.md -- named verbatim ("wallet charges") in all three run-specific override limits

*.reason: Refunds move money and are treated as a financial action.
*.source: Conservative default -- REFUND is NOT named in any project document; forbidden by fail-safe, not by migration

SelfCreated.reason: A booking this run itself creates, on STG_PORTAL/ANCILLARIES_STG, requires an explicit run-scoped authorization before it executes.
SelfCreated.source: HD-SAFETY-006 (user-approved 2026-09-28), scoped narrowly for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5

*.source: run_configuration.md -- named verbatim ("bookings") in all three run-specific override limits
run_configuration.md -- named verbatim ("holds") in all three run-specific override limits
run_configuration.md -- named verbatim ("ticketing") in all three run-specific override limits

*.reason: Cancelling a booking is a distinct business effect from creating one. Permission to BOOK would never have included it, and no permission to BOOK exists here anyway.
*.source: Conservative default -- CANCEL_BOOKING is NOT named in any project document

*.reason: Voiding is a distinct, irreversible business effect.
*.source: Conservative default -- VOID is NOT named in any project document

*.reason: This run uses one shared Super Admin account that stands in for two actors. Changing its credential would lock out the run and anyone else using it.
*.source: Conservative default -- informed by run_configuration.md, Credentials: the 2026-08-04 single-account directive
Conservative default -- no project evidence addresses role or permission changes

notes: HD-SAFETY-006 (2026-09-28): the booking/financial SelfCreated entries above (categories.booking, categories.financial, actions.BOOK/PAYMENT/WALLET_CHARGE) are a policy addition for the Ancillaries/AirIndia Supplier Feature run (run-007) -- see execution_safety_policy.md S3.5 for full provenance. Pure additions: every pre-existing rule is unchanged, and every ownership class other than SelfCreated remains exactly as absolutely forbidden as before.

NO MODULE OVERRIDES ARE DEFINED. Module- and entity-scoped overrides are fully supported by the evaluator, but no current project document establishes a rule that differs per module, and inventing one would violate the do-not-invent-permissions rule. Historical per-module grants (run-001 Agency, run-002 Branch, run-003 self-created Branch) were RUN authorizations, not standing project policy, and each states explicitly that it does not carry forward.

ABSOLUTE means no other policy rule, at any scope, can override this one. Separately, and independently of the flag: NO run-scoped authorization can ever lift a Forbidden decision (HD-SAFETY-001, 2026-08-07). A run authorization only ever satisfies an Approval Required.

PROSPECTIVE ONLY. This policy takes effect 2026-08-07 and governs runs created after it. run-001, run-002 and run-003 executed under the prose grants recorded in run_configuration.md and were NOT evaluated by this mechanism (HD-SAFETY-005, 2026-08-07).
